title: Firestore documents
description:
Shapes of the documents the Firebase sink writes (JSON view; created_at is a Firestore server timestamp, everything else is stored as shown). Layout:
  experiments/{exp}/admins/{email}                          allow-list, managed in the console
  experiments/{exp}/claims/{n}                              subject-number claims (doc id = string(n))
  experiments/{exp}/claims_by_uid/{uid}                     one claim per anonymous user (public mode)
  experiments/{exp}/data/{uid}/sessions/{subject}_{ses}     session record (session.schema.json)
  experiments/{exp}/data/{uid}/sessions/{...}/chunks/{i}    event chunks

status.description: reserved -> active (session started) -> complete | void. Stale reservations are released by an admin.

uid_marker.description: Created in the same batch as a public claim; limits each anonymous user to one subject number.

chunk.description: A slice of the event stream. Events are stored as one string because Firestore rejects nested arrays (pointer/gaze samples are arrays of arrays).

encoding.description: json = NDJSON text; gzip-base64 = gzip of that text, base64-encoded.
